name: io.github.vegetableno1/dualsphysics
title: DualSPHysics MCP
description: Agent toolchain for the DualSPHysics SPH fluid dynamics solver: case preparation (GenCase), background CPU simulation with progress parsing, post-processing to VTK/CSV, and quantitative dam-break validation against the Koshizuka & Oka (1996) experiment.

environmentVariables.name: DSPH_GENCASE
environmentVariables.description: Path to the GenCase_linux64 executable (auto-discovered if unset)

environmentVariables.name: DSPH_SOLVER
environmentVariables.description: Path to the DualSPHysics CPU solver executable (auto-discovered if unset)

environmentVariables.name: DSPH_PARTVTK
environmentVariables.description: Path to the PartVTK_linux64 executable (auto-discovered if unset)

environmentVariables.name: DSPH_MEASURETOOL
environmentVariables.description: Path to the MeasureTool_linux64 executable (auto-discovered if unset)

environmentVariables.name: DSPH_JOBS_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for simulation job outputs (defaults to ./jobs)

environmentVariables.name: DSPH_OMP_THREADS
environmentVariables.description: OpenMP threads for the CPU solver (defaults to CPU count)
